}}

{{recipe}} 

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] assorted dark leafy greens, such as [[Cookbook:Mustard Greens|mustard]], [[Cookbook:Collard Greens|collard]], and rainbow [[Cookbook:Chard|chard]]
* 8 rashers [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], cut into about ½-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] pieces
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] bacon fat (optional)
* 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] (optional)
* 1 ½ tsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] chicken [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]

== Procedure ==
#Cook bacon to slightly less than done in a large stainless steel pot. Drain.
#If desired, pour 1 tbsp bacon fat back into pot. Add greens, and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] over medium-high heat for 7 minutes.
#Add remaining ingredients and lower heat to medium low. Cook for 45 minutes. Defat if needed.
#Serve warm, with a vinegar-based, clear [[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|hot sauce]] to accompany.
